connector.name: NetSuite Link (beta)
connector.registryDescription: BETA - Run SuiteQL, read/write NetSuite records, query SuiteAnalytics, and run saved bookmarks.
connector.summary: Hosted at netsuite.solenium.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.solenium, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: NetSuite Link API key. Pins the request to one NetSuite account and connection, and gates which tools are exposed and callable (rest, jdbc, metadata, bookmarks, and the MCP channel).
